description: This file defines classes and methods for manufacturing resource planning (MRP) in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including workcenters, routing, bills of materials, production orders, procurement, and stock moves.

classes.name: mrp_workcenter
classes.description: Represents a workcenter used in manufacturing, with properties like name, type, capacity, times, and costs.

classes.name: mrp_property
classes.description: Defines properties associated with BoMs or workcenters.

classes.name: mrp_routing
classes.description: Defines a routing for manufacturing, including associated workcenters.

classes.name: mrp_routing_workcenter
classes.description: Associates workcenters with routing steps, including sequence and cycle info.

classes.name: mrp_bom
classes.description: Represents a Bill of Materials, including components, routing, and hierarchy logic.

classes.name: mrp_production
classes.description: Manages manufacturing orders, including planning, execution, and stock moves.

classes.name: stock_move
classes.description: Represents stock movements, extended here to link to manufacturing orders.

classes.name: mrp_production_workcenter_line
classes.description: Defines work order steps within a production order.

classes.name: mrp_production_product_line
classes.description: Defines products scheduled for production within a manufacturing order.

classes.name: mrp_procurement
classes.description: Handles procurement processes for raw materials and components.

classes.name: stock_warehouse_orderpoint
classes.description: Defines minimum stock rules for procurement.

classes.name: StockMove
classes.description: Extended stock move class with link to manufacturing orders.

classes.name: StockPicking
classes.description: Extended stock picking class with methods for exploding phantom BoMs and validation.

methods.name: _compute_type
methods.description: Determines BoM type based on supply and procurement methods.

methods.name: onchange_product_id
methods.description: Updates UOM and name when product changes.

methods.name: _bom_find
methods.description: Finds a BoM matching product and properties.

methods.name: _bom_explode
methods.description: Explodes a BoM into component list and routing steps.

methods.name: action_compute
methods.description: Computes the manufacturing order components and routing steps.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels a production order and related stock moves.

methods.name: action_production_end
methods.description: Completes production, updates stock moves, and records costs.

methods.name: test_if_product
methods.description: Checks if production has products scheduled.

methods.name: action_confirm
methods.description: Confirms a production order, creates stock moves and procurement.

methods.name: action_in_production
methods.description: Marks production as in progress and confirms stock moves.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels production and related stock moves.

methods.name: action_production_end
methods.description: Completes production, updates stock moves, and records costs.

methods.name: _action_explode
methods.description: Explodes phantom BoMs into stock moves and procurements.
